settings.heading: Can the Eminence 425 be converted to natural gas?
settings.text: No, the Eminence 425 is designed for propane use only and cannot be converted to natural gas.

settings.heading: Is the rear panel fully enclosed?
settings.text: Yes, the rear panel is fully enclosed. However, it can be easily opened to access and remove the grease tray before securely closing again.

settings.heading: Does my grill require assembly?
settings.text:
Yes. MG products require assembly. We provide instructional videos and digital manuals on our website

Learn More

settings.heading: Will accessories and the grill arrive together if I order a bundle?
settings.text: No, the grill and accessories are shipped separately and may arrive at different times.
